Trauma, anxiety and depression therapy in Texas

Reem Glasco, LPC-S, sees a small number of adults and young adults for developmental trauma, C-PTSD, anxiety, panic attacks, depression, procrastination and life transitions. Sessions are 50 minutes at $240 self-pay, online anywhere in Texas, with Blue Cross Blue Shield accepted. Because her caseload is limited by her supervision and consultation work, most new clients are seen by the practice's LPC Associates, who have openings including at sliding-scale fees. Trail walk sessions are available in person in central Texas for adults at $125 an hour.

What brings you?

Equine-assisted therapy

Sessions with the horses near Dripping Springs. What the body does around a thousand-pound animal that notices everything, and what that shows you. $185 to $240 for 1.5 to 2 hours.

Trauma and C-PTSD

Developmental trauma, complex PTSD, and EMDR that has stalled before. NARM, Somatic Experiencing and IFS-informed EMDR.

Anxiety and panic

Generalised anxiety, panic attacks, social anxiety, and a body that stays braced when nothing is happening.

Depression and flatness

Numbness, procrastination that does not respond to discipline, and a sense that something is off you cannot point at.

Walk and talk therapy

Outside, side by side rather than across a room. Fridays in central Texas, adults only, $125 an hour.

How IFS-informed EMDR, Somatic Experiencing and NARM fit together

Who you will see

Reem, or one of the associates?

Both are options, and the honest answer is usually availability. Reem holds a small caseload alongside supervising associates and consulting on EMDR. The associates she supervises are earlier in their careers, working under her supervision, with lower fees and more open calendars.

Meet the associates, with fees and direct contact for each

Who this is for

Adults and young adults, including college-age clients. The practice does not work with young children.

Alongside the four paths above, people come here for life transitions, graduating, leaving, arriving, becoming a parent, losing someone, and for self care for mothers, which usually starts with permission.

Trail walk, movement and equine sessions are for adults only, and need a consult plus one to three online sessions first, so we know each other before we are outside.

You do not have to sort yourself into the right page before making contact. The four overlap a great deal, and the consult is where the starting point gets chosen.

Online is the default. Walking and horses are the in-person exceptions.

How the work is done

Four methods, interlocking

Not four alternatives to choose between. They run together, and which one leads at a given moment is a clinical decision rather than something you pick in advance.

NARM

The pattern underneath, where it was learned, and what choice you have once you can see it happening rather than only feel it.

Somatic Experiencing

Shock trauma met a little at a time, slow and gentle, building your window of tolerance rather than testing it.

EMDR

What EMDR actually involves, who it suits, and what tends to be behind it when it has stalled somewhere before.

IFS-informed EMDR

Reem's main focus. The protective parts of you are consulted before anything is processed, and most of the emphasis sits in that preparation.

How the four fit together, in plain language

Common questions about therapy here

How much does a therapy session cost?

$240 for a 50-minute online session with Reem, self-pay. Trail walk and movement sessions are $125 for an hour. The practice's LPC Associates see clients at lower fees, including sliding scale.

Do you take insurance?

Blue Cross Blue Shield is accepted. Sessions under any other plan are self-pay, by major credit card. If you plan to seek out-of-network reimbursement from another insurer, raise it in the consult so you know what documentation to expect.

Is therapy in person or online?

Online across Texas is the default. In person means trail walk and movement therapy on Fridays, or equine sessions near Dripping Springs, both for adults, both after a consult and one to three online sessions.

What happens in a first session?

Mostly orientation: what brought you, what you want different, what your nervous system does under stress, and how we will pace the work. Nothing about trauma gets opened faster than you can stay present for.

Which page should I read?

Start with whichever of trauma, anxiety, depression or walk and talk sounds most like your week. They overlap a great deal, and you do not have to sort yourself correctly before a consult. The approach page explains the methods that run through all of them.

What if I need help sooner than you have openings?

Ask about the associates, who generally have availability sooner and lower fees. If neither fits, Reem will refer you out rather than leave you on a waitlist. If you are in immediate danger, call 911; for a mental health crisis, call or text 988.

Ready when you are

Start with a conversation

Therapy consults are fifteen minutes. Supervision and EMDR consultation consults are thirty. Both are free and commit you to nothing.
